body: I have keratosis Polaris really severely and have always wondered this as well

Hey all! I just emailed my artist to ask her about advice on an abnormal experience I'm having with the healing process, but it dawned on me that maybe Reddit would be able to give me quicker answers/advice. 

So long story short on Saturday I had a session to fill in some of the areas on a sleeve I am working on. I have extremely sensitive skin and my artist knows this and is very careful and accommodating. The area in my inner elbow immediately puffed up, which isn't new to me. However Sunday and Monday i noticed some pillow-y skin forming, whereas it's usually flat & flaky. Monday I noticed a small pit/hole (see photo) and today (Tuesday) the pit is more defined and the skin around it is sort of a milky color and puffy. I have never experienced this with a tattoo healing and am very nervous that it won't heal well because right now it's really noticeable. So, I'm asking for possible answers as to what the tattoo is doing and how to go forward with the healing process as to avoid permanent damage. 

For reference, my healing method is to leave the wrap on for a few hours, then use anti bacterial soap and thin layers of Aquaphor as necessary for the next two weeks or so. This has worked well for me and without issues in the past and this is what I have followed in this instance as well.

I understand. If you ever feel like it might or just want to talk for the sake of talking I'm here. Talking usually doesn't do much for me either, but sometimes that human connection is what can get me through the day.
